headline: Storm warning for 5 regions with 60 km/h winds as low pressure forms over the sea
summary: A low-pressure system is forming over the Bay of Bengal, raising concerns for very heavy rainfall and gusty winds up to 60 km/h in at least five regions across Bangladesh.
details: A low-pressure area is developing over the Bay of Bengal, prompting warnings for adverse weather conditions. Five regions in Bangladesh are currently under a storm warning.
Authorities anticipate gusty winds reaching speeds of up to 60 kilometers per hour in these five areas. Very heavy rainfall is also forecast across the affected regions.
This weather system indicates a potential for significant impact, following previous instances of heavy rain in the country. Residents in vulnerable areas are advised to stay informed.
caption:

headline: Home Minister warns Sheikh Hasina will be arrested upon her return to Bangladesh in December
summary: Bangladesh's Home Minister has stated that Sheikh Hasina will be arrested upon her return to the country in December, following her announcement of an impending return.
details: Sheikh Hasina has announced her intention to return to Bangladesh in December. This announcement has sparked significant political discussion ahead of her planned arrival.
Following her statement, the Home Minister publicly declared that Sheikh Hasina would be arrested immediately upon her return to the country. This indicates potential legal action awaiting her.
caption:
Bangladesh's political landscape is heating up as the Home Minister warns of Sheikh Hasina's arrest upon her December return.

Sheikh Hasina has announced her intention to return to Bangladesh in December. This announcement has sparked significant political discussion ahead of her planned arrival.

Following her statement, the Home Minister publicly declared that Sheikh Hasina would be arrested immediately upon her return to the country. This indicates potential legal action awaiting her.
